instruction: Use ug-surveillance cameras to list all cameras with name, location and status. Read only. Do not return faces, plates or snapshots.

Use ug-surveillance faces with identity-type known to check whether exactly one known identity is named Ana Ruiz. Read only. Return yes or no, and if no, only the registered names that are closest to Ana Ruiz. Do not return images or details of anyone.

Use ug-document extract with schema auto and content-scope full on the file Invoices/Ana Ruiz - Nov 2-3 r.pdf. Return one row per billed visit with date, start time, end time, billed hours, hourly rate, line amount, worker name and number of workers, plus the exact text each value was read from. Also return the bill total, currency and the period printed on the bill. Leave a value empty when it is not printed; do not compute or infer missing values. List any page or line that could not be read.

Use ug-surveillance event-timeline from 2026-11-02 00:00 to 2026-11-04 12:00 in time zone America/New_York, for the cameras Front Door, with topic Human and HumanFace, identity-type known, person-name Ana Ruiz and limit 500. Return every event with its event id, local time, camera and the identity name exactly as recorded, and say whether the list was cut at the limit. Read only. Do not return events of any other person. Report any warning about missing recordings or offline cameras.

Use ug-surveillance event-timeline in time zone America/New_York for the cameras Front Door on these dates only: 2026-11-03, with topic Human and HumanFace, identity-type all and limit 500. For each event return only its local time, its camera and whether the person was recognised as a known identity (yes or no). Do not return names, faces, plates, snapshots or other details. Say whether any list was cut at the limit, and report any warning about missing recordings or offline cameras.

said:
**Fair Hours: Ana Ruiz, 2026-11-02 to 2026-11-03 (America/New_York)**
Bill: Invoices/Ana Ruiz - Nov 2-3 r.pdf. Cameras: Front Door (entrance). Tolerance: 10 min, no agreed terms.

| Date | Billed | Seen at entry cameras | Difference | Result | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Mon 2026-11-02 | 09:00-12:00 (3 h 00 min) | 09:02-11:58 (2 h 56 min) | 4 min | Confirmed | 2 events |
| Tue 2026-11-03 | 08:00-12:00 (4 h 00 min) | 08:00-09:30 (1 h 30 min) | billed 2 h 30 min more than seen, not counted | Inconclusive: the camera was not recording at arrival or departure | 2 events |

**Totals**
- Billed: 7 h 00 min over 2 visits.
- Confirmed: 3 h 00 min over 1 visit.
- Billed more than seen: 0 h 00 min over 0 visits.
- Seen more than billed: 0 h 00 min over 0 visits, including no dates seen but not billed.
- Not seen while the cameras recognised other people: 0 h 00 min over 0 visits.
- Inconclusive: 4 h 00 min over 1 visit. Reason: the Front Door was not recording from 10:00 to 13:00 on 2026-11-03.
- At the printed rates: no differences in either direction to price.

**Bill arithmetic:** all lines check out (3 h x USD 25 = USD 75; 4 h x USD 25 = USD 100; total USD 175).

**Passages on 2026-11-03:** four passages on the Front Door, all of recognised people; none unrecognised.

**What this means:** the 2026-11-02 visit matches the cameras within 4 minutes. On 2026-11-03 the cameras saw Ana Ruiz from 08:00 to 09:30, but the Front Door was not recording from 10:00 to 13:00, so the end of the billed visit cannot be checked. That row stays Inconclusive and is not counted as time not worked. Camera times show passages through the entry, not the work done between them. A good starting point is to go through the 2026-11-03 visit with Ana, beginning with the time after 09:30.

I can also pull snapshots for the 2026-11-03 row for you to review on the NAS. Do you want me to save this report on the NAS? If yes, tell me which folder.
